observation: The kit is the works part place_works_inclusion_kit, instanced by the asteroid-works renderer. Isolated fleet-look of the release GLB: 18 draws, Material_InclusionAtlas, about 12.4 by 0.82 by 5.5. Chase and close show eighteen separate mineral chips in a grid, each with its own inclusion. That is the part. The drill-screen placement shot this pass still caught the boot splash (sf-boot-open hides the screen while the drill node already has a box), so in-works placement is not in this frame.
decision: Capture stands for the part. No builder edit. Eighteen chips is the kit, not a broken mesh.
next: Orchestrator judges the chips. A later drill frame can show them seated in the works.
